# Runtime + dev deps for the RTO Trust Layer.
# Runtime libs are mirrored in pyproject.toml [project].dependencies; dev tools
# (pytest, ruff) are mirrored in [project.optional-dependencies].dev. Keep the
# three lists in sync — uv.lock is regenerated by `scripts/refresh_lockfile.sh`.
#
# Day 6 Track 12-bc — re-added `shap>=0.42` (was removed earlier as a "dead
# dep — never imported". Now actually wired into `src/models/explain.py` via
# the new `explain_with_shap()` function (Lundberg 2017 NeurIPS KernelSHAP).
# KernelExplainer is the right choice for the live HistGB model — TreeExplainer
# doesn't support HistGB's internal node structure (per the prompt-razor's
# line 1737 note). Dual-mode: if `shap` isn't installed, the
# `explain_with_shap()` function returns a graceful fallback dict pointing at
# the existing `reason_codes` (LIME-equivalent) field in /risk/score's
# response, so the 141 existing tests pass without a `shap` install.
#
# Day 2 Track E additions (Postgres + Alembic dual-mode):
#   - psycopg[binary]>=3.1   : raw psycopg v3 driver for Postgres (NO SQLAlchemy ORM,
#                              per 04-TECH-STACK-DECISIONS.md — V3 rejected heavy ORMs)
#   - alembic>=1.13          : schema migrations; raw-SQL `op.execute()` style
#   - pydantic-settings>=2.0 : typed Settings with .env support (replaces ad-hoc
#                              os.environ reads scattered across src/api/security.py
#                              + src/audit/logger.py)
#   - cachetools>=5.3        : TTLCache for the file-mode idempotency cache — closes
#                              the §A item 2 unbounded-dict memory leak even when
#                              DATABASE_URL is unset (test mode)
# Day 2 Track F additions (Redis Streams streaming backbone):
#   - redis>=5.0             : redis-py with Streams support (XADD / XREADGROUP /
#                              XACK / PFADD / PFCOUNT). Closes §A item 18 (Redis
#                              declared but unused) + driver G2 (REST-only, no
#                              event/streaming backbone). NOT Kafka per
#                              04-TECH-STACK-DECISIONS.md: "V3 explicitly rejected
#                              Kafka as cargo-cult"; Redis Streams is sufficient +
#                              has upgrade path.
# Day 6 Track 12-bc — SHAP + OTel instrumentation additions:
#   - shap>=0.42             : SHAP KernelExplainer for the /v1/explain/shap
#                              endpoint (Lundberg & Lee 2017 NeurIPS §3
#                              "KernelSHAP"). Dual-mode via try/except ImportError
#                              so the API still boots without it.
#   - opentelemetry-distro>=0.50: meta-package that pulls the API + SDK +
#                              a convenience `otelconf.py` for instrumentation
#                              setup. Closes V2 §9.2 (observability stack) for
#                              real alongside the existing api/sdk/exporter-otlp.
#   - opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi>=0.50 : auto-creates server spans
#                              for each HTTP request, with route + method +
#                              status attributes. Called by `instrument_app()`
#                              at the end of create_app().
#   - opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests>=0.50 : auto-creates client spans
#                              for outbound `requests.*` calls (the ingest
#                              simulators + lazy connect paths). Called by
#                              `instrument_app()`.
#   - opentelemetry-instrumentation-psycopg>=0.50 : auto-creates DB spans for
#                              every psycopg query (audit logger INSERT, mandate
#                              counter read/write, idempotency cache, model
#                              registry). Called by `instrument_app()`.
# Day 4 Track M — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for the /risk/score decision
# pipeline. Closes V2 §9.2 "observability stack" gap: the Jaeger + OTel
# wiring lets the demo show distributed traces end-to-end (REST → mandate
# check → cost-optimizer → audit → stream publish). Dual-mode: if
# OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT is unset the tracer is None + the spans
# become no-ops (the 93 existing tests still pass without a Jaeger
# fixture — same pattern as Track E's DATABASE_URL and Track F's REDIS_URL).

numpy>=1.26
scikit-learn>=1.8
fastapi>=0.136
uvicorn>=0.30
httpx>=0.28
psycopg[binary]>=3.1
alembic>=1.13
pydantic-settings>=2.0
cachetools>=5.3
redis>=5.0
# Day 6 Track 12-bc — SHAP KernelExplainer for /v1/explain/shap
# (Lundberg & Lee 2017 NeurIPS §3 "KernelSHAP").
shap>=0.42
# Day 4 Track M — OpenTelemetry core (API + SDK + OTLP exporter). The
# 3 packages below are the minimum for the manual span on /risk/score.
opentelemetry-api>=1.20

opentelemetry-exporter-otlp>=1.20

# (try/except ImportError inside src/api/otel.py::instrument_app) so the
# API boots even if these packages aren't installed in the sandbox.
